prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the radiator support shows bending consistent with a frontal strike at low speed. The hood latch and both headlamp assemblies are damaged, and the grille has lost its mounting tabs. Most of what I see lines up with the impact as described. The shop's labor hours fit the repair work outlined, and I found no sign of earlier damage to this vehicle. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are still being verified before final approval. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, hood latch, and headlamps, with frame measurements taken before any structural work begins.
